# LedgerFlow

LedgerFlow helps finance teams reconcile invoices automatically. In interviews with 20 finance leaders, teams reported spending eight hours per week on manual reconciliation.

We have 18 paying customers, $216,000 ARR, and 92% gross retention after six months. Our $1,000 monthly subscription has a $2,400 customer-acquisition cost and an estimated 18-month lifetime.

We are raising a $1.5m seed round to hire two engineers and expand our channel partnership program.
